verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of data retention policies, configurable retention periods, or user- or admin-controlled deletion of data, including AI and agent data. The nearest items are hosting and compliance claims (SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO, 'data never leaves our secure servers') and agent access scoping and auditing. These are adjacent security controls, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
